questions.prompt: Which conflict is also known as the War Between the States?
questions.fact: More soldiers died of disease than of wounds, and the total dead exceeded American losses in both world wars combined.

questions.prompt: Which gas is most responsible for the greenhouse effect on Venus?
questions.fact: It makes up about ninety-six percent of that atmosphere, and the surface is hot enough to melt lead.

questions.prompt: Which sport awards the Green Jacket to its champion?
questions.fact: The winner may take it home for a year, after which it must remain at the club.

questions.prompt: Which film trilogy is set in Middle-earth?
questions.fact: All three parts were shot at once over roughly fifteen months, which had never been attempted at that scale.

questions.prompt: Which island nation lies off the southeastern coast of Africa?
questions.fact: It separated from other landmasses so long ago that the overwhelming majority of its wildlife exists nowhere else.

questions.prompt: Which novel is narrated by Holden Caulfield?
questions.fact: Its author published nothing after 1965 and spent his last decades refusing interviews and blocking adaptations.

questions.prompt: What does 'bandwidth' measure on a network?
questions.fact: It is often confused with latency, but a high-capacity link can still feel slow if each message takes long to arrive.
